# Docs Static Assets Agent Instructions

## Owner

- `baldin_full_stack_architect`.

## Scope

- Applies to static docs assets.

## Do

- Keep assets small, intentional, and referenced by authored docs.
- Prefer replacing stale assets over accumulating duplicates.

## Do Not

- Do not store generated build output here.
- Do not include secrets or private data.

## Validation

- Run docs build when asset references affect published pages and validation is requested.
- Check for stale links or references.

## Handback Notes

- List added, replaced, or removed assets.
